Rome, Lourdes, Fátima — 14 Days

Europe's three principal places of pilgrimage in one journey — St Peter's Basilica in Rome, the grotto at Massabielle in Lourdes, and the Cova da Iria at Fátima.

Duration
14 days
Departures
March – December
Route
Rome · Lourdes · Fátima
Accompanied by
Tour leader & spiritual director

About this journey

This programme links the three places Catholic pilgrims travel to most in Europe: the centre of the universal Church in Rome, the grotto where Our Lady appeared to St Bernadette at Lourdes, and the Cova da Iria at Fátima, site of the 1917 apparitions.

As with every JB Tour programme, the group travels with an experienced tour leader and a spiritual director, and everything the journey needs — flights, hotels, restaurants and documents — is arranged from Jakarta.

Day by day

A sample schedule. The order of visits follows Mass times, basilica opening hours and flight conditions.

  1. Day 1 — Jakarta

    Gather at Soekarno-Hatta Airport for a briefing with the tour leader and spiritual director, then the flight to Europe.

  2. Day 2 — Arrive in Rome

    Arrival in Rome and transfer to the hotel. Opening Mass for the group, then rest after the long flight.

  3. Day 3 — The Vatican

    St Peter's Basilica, the Pietà, the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel. The papal general audience if the departure falls on a Wednesday.

  4. Day 4 — Rome

    The Basilica of St Mary Major, the Basilica of St John Lateran, and the Holy Stairs.

  5. Day 5 — Rome – Assisi – Rome

    A day trip to Assisi: the Basilica of St Francis and the Basilica of St Clare.

  6. Day 6 — Rome – Lourdes

    Flight to Lourdes. First prayers at the grotto at Massabielle in the afternoon, and the candlelight procession that evening.

  7. Day 7 — Lourdes

    Mass at the grotto, the Lourdes baths, and the Stations of the Cross on the hillside.

  8. Day 8 — Lourdes

    Time for private prayer, the Sacrament of Reconciliation, and the Blessed Sacrament procession.

  9. Day 9 — Lourdes – Fátima

    Overland across Spain into Portugal, stopping at pilgrimage towns along the route.

  10. Day 10 — Fátima

    Mass at the Chapel of the Apparitions, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary, the tombs of St Francisco and St Jacinta, and the candlelight procession.

  11. Day 11 — Fátima

    Aljustrel and Valinhos, where the shepherd children lived and where the angel appeared.

  12. Day 12 — Fátima – Lisbon

    On to Lisbon. A visit to the Church of St Anthony and free time in the city centre.

  13. Day 13 — Lisbon

    Closing Mass and time to buy devotional items before heading to the airport.

  14. Day 14 — Arrive in Jakarta

    Arrival back in Jakarta.
